system.description: Standard 10mm full metal jacket rounds. The most common pistol and SMG calibre on Mort. Available at every Shiver station, most corner shops, and all operative supply depots.
Armour-piercing 10mm rounds with a hardened steel penetrator core. Each hit reduces target's armour dice by 1 (in addition to weapon AP). More expensive but essential against armoured targets.
Standard 9mm parabellum. Compatible with the FEN 603 and similar machine pistols. High velocity, moderate stopping power.
Standard 5.56mm intermediate rifle rounds. Fits the FEN AR and compatible assault rifles. High velocity, good accuracy at medium range.
5.56mm armour-piercing rounds for assault rifles. Penetrator core defeats light armour. Essential for engagements against armoured Shivers or operative-grade targets.
Full-power 7.62mm rifle rounds. Fits the Browbeater series, FEN Reaper LMG, and similar battle rifles. More penetrating than intermediate calibres.
7.62mm armour-piercing for battle rifles and LMGs. Defeats medium armour consistently. Standard upgrade for sustained-fire engagements against armoured targets.
Standard 12-gauge buckshot shells. Devastating at close range, poor at anything else. Each shell fires a spread pattern covering Engaged range with full damage, Short range at -1 damage.
12-gauge rifled slugs. A single heavy projectile instead of a spread pattern. Retains full damage at Short range. Gains AP 1. Less area coverage but better penetration than buckshot.
Heavy .44 revolver rounds for the BLA 046M Blitzer. Slow to reload, high stopping power. Each round hits harder than comparable pistol calibres.
Heavy-calibre pistol rounds for the FEN 204 Heavy Pistol. High recoil, high damage. The round that makes the compensator necessary.
High-explosive 40mm grenade round for the MILA launcher. On impact, deals DMG 5 within Engaged range of blast point, DMG 2 at Short range. Armour dice halved against blast.
40mm smoke grenade round for the MILA launcher. Creates a dense smoke cloud at Short range radius on impact. All ranged attacks through the cloud are at -2 dice. Dissipates after 3 rounds.
